headline: Palace arrive after a 0-5, and Beşiktaş are the favourites
summary: Crystal Palace travel to Istanbul after a 0-5 defeat at Brighton on Sunday, and they arrive as the underdog. Beşiktaş have won both Europa League matches, scoring seven goals, though they lost 0-2 at Trabzonspor on Monday and are without Orkun Kökçü, who has played 701 minutes this season. Palace have conceded chances worth 2.17 expected goals per game across their last five. Across 10 bookmakers, margin removed, Beşiktaş are 46.4% to win — more than one and a half times Palace's chance. The market expects about 3.1 goals, and over 3 has moved from 50.9% to 53.0%. A home win, but a narrow one.
read: Beşiktaş are 46.4% favourites to make it three Europa League wins from three, against a Crystal Palace side beaten 0-5 at Brighton on Sunday and whose manager is reported to be under pressure. sources.fact: Beşiktaş head coach Vincenzo Italiano said he will make changes to the lineup against Crystal Palace and named who will replace the injured Orkun Kökçü.
Turkish media report that Orkun Kökçü will miss the Crystal Palace match through injury.
Beşiktaş have won their opening two Europa League matches, beating Marseille 4-1 and Hoffenheim 3-2, scoring seven times.
Beşiktaş are looking to put their 2-0 Süper Lig defeat at Trabzonspor behind them and make it three Europa League wins from three with the support of their fans.
Premier League scouts will attend Beşiktaş's Süper Lig match against Trabzonspor to watch breakout star İlhan Fakılı, per Turkish Football.
Beşiktaş head coach Vincenzo Italiano gave a press conference before the Crystal Palace match and set out his biggest targets.
BBC Sport reports that Crystal Palace boss Pierre Sage is facing a fight to keep his job but will be given more time.
Crystal Palace lost 5-0 to rivals Brighton in the Premier League on Sunday, conceding three times in the first 10 minutes.
